script: (() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.startPlaying(true); g.hud.helpQueue = []; g.hud.helpT = 0.01; g.simulate(0.3); const L = g.layout; const b = L.blocks.find((q) => q.style === 'downtown' && !q.poi && q.cx > 0); g.p1 = { x: L.inner(b).x0 + 14, z: b.z1 - 2.2 }; g.player.pos.set(g.p1.x, 0.15, g.p1.z); g.player.yaw = Math.PI / 2; g.cam.yaw = Math.PI / 2 + 0.25; g.cam.mode = 'mid'; g.traffic.prefill(g.player.pos, 12); g.peds.prefill(g.player.pos, 14); g.simulate(1.5, ['KeyW']); return g.debugState(); })()
(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.player.pos.set(g.p1.x, 0.15, g.p1.z); g.cam.yaw = Math.PI / 2 + 0.25; g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(2.6); return g.debugState(); })()
(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.simulate(2.5); return g.debugState(); })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(2.2); const L = g.layout; const r = L.zs[10]; const x = (L.xs[6].pos + L.xs[7].pos) / 2; const v = g.traffic.spawnVehicle(g.vehicleDefs.arrow, x - 60, r.pos + 2.25, Math.PI / 2, { color: '#e8e8ec' }); const d = v.doorPoint(1); g.player.pos.set(d.x, 0.15, d.z); g.simulate(0.2); g.simulate(2.5, [], ['KeyF']); g.env.hours = 19.2; g.env.lastEnvElev = 999; g.simulate(3.0, ['KeyW']); return g.debugState(); })()
(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(2.2, ['KeyW']); return g.debugState(); })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(2, ['KeyS']); g.exitVehicleNow(); g.env.hours = 14.5; g.env.lastEnvElev = 999; const fr = g.layout.frost; g.player.pos.set(fr.roadX + 8, 0.0, -960); g.player.yaw = Math.PI; g.cam.yaw = Math.PI + 0.2; g.cam.pitch = 0.13; g.simulate(3.0); return g.debugState(); })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; const fr = g.layout.frost; g.player.pos.set(fr.lake.x - fr.lake.r - 6, 0.0, fr.lake.z + 10); g.player.yaw = Math.PI / 2 + 0.3; g.cam.yaw = Math.PI / 2 + 0.3; g.simulate(2.0); return g.debugState(); })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.player.pos.set(g.p1.x, 0.15, g.p1.z); g.cam.yaw = Math.PI / 2 + 0.25; g.env.hours = 21.4; g.env.lastEnvElev = 999; g.traffic.prefill(g.player.pos, 12); g.peds.prefill(g.player.pos, 14); g.simulate(1.5); return g.debugState(); })()
